The EfficientNetB3 model compares the image against four trained classes.
The displayed disease is the class with the highest softmax probability.
Classes are Bacterial Blight, Brown Spot, Healthy, and Leaf Blast.
Confidence is calculated using softmax from the model logits.
Model confidence is not the same as guaranteed diagnostic accuracy.
Severity estimates how much of the visible leaf area appears affected by disease symptoms.
Current severity is a Grad-CAM attention-area proxy.
Heatmap values are normalized from 0 to 1.
severity = active Grad-CAM pixels / total pixels × 100
This is an indicative attention proxy, not an exact lesion segmentation result.
Climate Risk represents how favorable current or supplied environmental conditions are for disease development.
Loss Risk estimates the potential crop impact based on disease severity and other configured risk factors.
raw loss = disease base risk + 0.32 × severity percentage + 0.18 × affected-field percentage + 0.12 × climate-risk percentage
loss risk = raw loss × growth-stage factor
Estimated Loss converts the predicted loss risk into an approximate crop quantity.
expected healthy yield = field area in acres × expected yield in kg per acre
estimated production loss = expected healthy yield × loss-risk percentage / 100
The Case ID identifies the saved prediction and can later connect farmer feedback, expert validation, and actual harvest outcomes.
